text:
kai: quick note from today's canary: when we hot-swap quant profiles mid-sequence the runtime sometimes applies an old per-channel scale to later KV cache entries, causing subtle bias shifts. saw it on fp8->int8 path.
rachel: interesting. did you see it only with longctx?
kai: mostly sequences >512 and with interleaved short/long requests. probable cause: cache entries lack provenance metadata tying them to a quant-profile version.
omar: we should tag KV cache entries with a small header: `profile_id` + `scale_version`. cheap, avoids mixing scales across swaps. also add a quick runtime assert on apply: if entry.profile_id != active.profile_id then skip.
rachel: agree. also propose a lightweight on-disk serialization format for quant profiles so we can atomically swap at runtime: simple header + per-layer floats + crc. e.g. `QP v1 | model | profile_uuid | layer_count | data... | crc32`. avoid JSON for hot path.
kai: +1 on atomic swaps. runtime should load new profile to memory, validate crc, then CAS-swap pointer used by inference workers.
omar: add fallback: if crc fails or profile incompatible, runtime should auto-backoff to last-known-good profile and emit `quant.swap.failure` telemetry.
rachel: API side: expose `profile_opt_in` flag per-endpoint so customers can opt into experimental fp8 profiles. default off. we need to track cost and quality per-customer.
kai: ops: please add canary metric `kv.profile_mismatch` and a debug sample of the offending request when mismatch occurs. limit samples to 1/10k to avoid PII leaks.
infra-bot: deploy-note: quant-profile-serialization drafted, CI job `quant-serialize` added.
omar: action items: omar -> implement profile_id tag in KV cache + runtime assert; kai -> add atomic loader + crc checks; rachel -> write profile binary spec + docs + api flag; ops -> enable telemetry and sample exporter.
rachel: small example spec snippet for docs (binary blob, but showing fields): ```text
QPv1|model:llama-13b|uuid:abc123|layers:40|floats...|crc:0x12af
```
omar: one more thing: add an ops-only toggle to force-evict KV entries when swapping major-profile versions to avoid long-tail mismatches.
kai: agreed. default behavior: try live swap, if kv.mismatch rate > 0.01% within 5m then auto-evict and fall back.
rachel: ok aiming for PR today. will run 72h shadow with `profile_opt_in=true` for a small cohort.
infra-bot: reminder: PR template at https://git.redwood/infra/quant-profiles contains rollout checklist. :rocket:
